mechanism_summary: The payments-gateway Service in the payments namespace carries the selector app=payments-gateway while the gateway pods carry the label app=payments-gateway-api, so that Service's Endpoints object never populates and every call the storefront checkout workload sends through its ExternalName alias reaches a Service with no backing addresses, even though the gateway pods themselves are Ready.
decisive_evidence: Endpoints payments/payments-gateway has no addresses while both payments-gateway-api pods are Running and Ready; the Service spec in payments shows selector app=payments-gateway against pod labels app=payments-gateway-api; service/payments-gateway in storefront is an ExternalName whose target is payments-gateway.payments.svc.cluster.local, and the storefront/checkout-api logs record 'payment gateway UNREACHABLE' against that alias.
remediation_summary: Correct the selector on the payments-gateway Service in the payments namespace to match the pod labels - kubectl -n payments patch service payments-gateway -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"payments-gateway-api"}}}' - Endpoints then populates with both gateway pod IPs, the checkout readiness gate passes, and storefront/checkout-api returns to 2 of 2 Ready with no change to any object in the storefront namespace.
